summary: Cline's August 26, 2026 announcement says GLM-5.3 Flash (formerly Ox Alpha) is free in Cline. The current Cline documentation says free model promotions are available to any user with a Cline account, provide a limited usage quota, rotate over time, and work in the Cline IDE extension and CLI—not the Cline API. No fixed end date is published, so this listing uses a null expiry date to mean no announced end date, not permanent availability.
claim_steps: Install the Cline CLI if needed: npm i -g cline.
Open the model picker with /models; in the current CLI, go to /settings, select Cline as the provider, and browse available free models.
Select GLM-5.3 Flash (Ox Alpha) under the free options while it is listed.
Use it in the Cline CLI or IDE extension within the limited free quota; Cline's free models are not available through the Cline API.

It’s been our fastest growing model in Cline history, now driving over 11% of all traffic in less than a week.

social_proof.title: Cline Free Models - Cline
social_proof.text: Cline periodically offers free model promotions that let you try select models at no cost, up to a limited usage quota. Free model promotions are offered on a rotating, limited-time basis. Free models are available to any user with a Cline account. Free model usage is not supported through the Cline API. Free models are only available in the Cline IDE Extension and CLI.
